title: Hoover High School
text:
This tournament is in Alabama, and had a great turnout in 2007. Consisting of 25 questions, each 4 points each, and 1 point off for an incorrect answer, it is well-run.

There are trophies in each division, 10 for small schools, and 10 for large schools. Some people don't like that, since if you are in a large school, it's harder to earn a trophy and very easy in the small school division.

The trophies this year were really small.
